connections.description: External connections, one values layer per connection file. Not used by this chart.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

enabled.title: Reloader
enabled.description: Restart pods when their ConfigMaps or Secrets change.

enabled.title: Replicator
enabled.description: Replicate Secrets and ConfigMaps between namespaces.

enabled.title: Deletion protection
enabled.description: Refuse to delete CRDs, namespaces and controllers carrying the label below set to "true".

crdGroups.title: Protected CRD groups
crdGroups.description: CRDs of these API groups and their subgroups cannot be deleted, labelled or not.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream charts this chart renders, one object per chart, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

reloader.title: reloader
reloader.description: Values of the reloader chart 2.2.17 (https://stakater.github.io/stakater-charts), rendered when reloader.enabled is set: image, reloader.deployment (resources, nodeSelector, tolerations), reloader.logLevel, reloader.ignoreNamespaces, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, reloader.rbac.enabled, reloader.serviceAccount.create, reloader.watchGlobally, reloader.isOpenshift, reloader.isArgoRollouts, reloader.serviceMonitor.enabled, reloader.verticalPodAutoscaler.enabled, reloader.deployment.env.secret.

kubernetes-replicator.title: kubernetes-replicator
kubernetes-replicator.description: Values of the kubernetes-replicator chart 2.12.4 (https://helm.mittwald.de), rendered when replicator.enabled is set: image, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, replicationEnabled.configMaps/roles/roleBindings/serviceAccounts, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, namespaceOverride, grantClusterAdmin, serviceAccount.create, serviceAccount.privileges, namespacesPrivileges, replicationEnabled.secrets, replicationEnabled.privileges, replicationEnabled.rolesPrivileges, args, verticalPodAutoscaler.enabled.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
